status: post-hoc diagnostic analysis; official scores unchanged

method.validity: Frozen eval.validate.parse; the existing full JSON code-fence allowance is retained.
method.final_correct: Exact equality of the parsed final state and the simulator final state.
method.unchanged_final: Parsed final state equals the complete initial map; invalid responses are excluded.
method.parent_accuracy: Fraction of final parent entries correct within each response, then mean across 400 responses; invalid responses contribute zero.
method.changed_parent_accuracy: Restrict to labels whose true final parent differs from its initial parent; average the fraction correct per response across 400 responses; invalid responses contribute zero.
method.initial_copy_baseline: Return the unchanged initial map on every task; average per-parent accuracy across the same 400 task-condition pairs.
method.unit: Descriptive only: five presentations share each of 80 tasks; 400 responses are not 400 independent forests.
method.official_rows_checked: Every raw response was matched by task ID and condition to its official score row; format_error and final_correct agree for all 800.
